defects.canonical: The final (failed) attempt still sleeps for its full backoff via time.sleep(delay) before the loop ends and the exception is re-raised, wasting one entire backoff interval after there is nothing left to retry.
defects.why_subtle: The sleep sits inside the normal except block and looks correct per-iteration; the wasted wait on the last failure is only visible when reasoning about loop termination.

defects.canonical: range(1, attempts) iterates attempts-1 times, so the function makes one fewer attempt than requested (e.g. attempts=3 yields only 2 calls).
defects.why_subtle: Intentional calibration anchor: an attentive reader spots the off-by-one in range(1, attempts) immediately.
